messages:
maria: heads-up team  change window opens in 10m for runtime release v5.12. plan: canary start at +0, hold at 5% for 6m, then ramp to 25% if stable. SLOs to watch: gen_p99 < 220ms, 5xx < 0.5% global. observability-bot will drop snapshots.
ajay: ack. i'll take first watchblock 0-20m. will have traces and heap dumps ready.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: v5.12 -> service=runtime-gpu; canary=2 pods; ramp=timed; start_ts=1779501234.
observability-bot: baseline snapshot: https://obs.internal/redwood/dashboards/slo?range=20m  baselines: gen_p99=190ms, p95=85ms, 5xx=0.11%.
derek: preflight checklist: circuit-breakers=fail-open ✅, kvcache prewarm ✅, quant-fallback enabled ✅.
maria: thresholds enforced from change-window doc: pause+rollback if gen_p99 > 260ms for 3m OR 5xx > 0.8% for 2m. we'll prefer partial pins before global rollback.
lee: paste runbook snippet for pause+partial pin? want steps to act fast.
maria: runbook excerpt:
```
1) /deploy pause canary
2) apply routing pin (scope: region or global) -> model_variant=v5.11
3) notify infra, support, and CS
4) open revert PR and block ramp
5) monitor for 10m then decide
```
ajay: confirm: smart-routing has fallback to ded-legacy and cpu-burst in the region policy (10% weights). keep that on standby.
observability-bot: canary started @ +0m. canary_pods=[gpu-21,gpu-22]. initial traffic=5%.
user-monitor: alert at +6m: gen_p95 increased to 138ms (baseline 85ms).
ajay: p95 up but p99 still within target. pulling traces and pod metrics now.
derek: sampled traces show backlog on attention kernel on gpu-21, likely allocator stalls after recent memory path change.
maria: hold ramp to 25%. ajay keep 5% traffic and run pod heatmap across regions.
ajay: heatmap shows us-west spike on gpu-21: GPU_utilization 96%, others ~60%. memory allocator retries flagged.
observability-bot: errorbudget updated: remaining 68% -> 61% after recent noise. anomaly tag: "allocator-oom-retries" in us-west.
lee: suggestion: partial regional pin to limit blast radius. can we pin us-west to previous variant only?
maria: doing partial pin now.
maria: /routing pin service=runtime-gpu region=us-west model_variant=v5.11
deploy-bot: routing change applied: service=runtime-gpu region=us-west pinned_to=v5.11
ajay: traces confirm us-west now routed to v5.11. global canary still 5% on v5.12 elsewhere.
user-monitor: follow-up alert: us-west 5xx dropped to 0.04% after pin. :white_check_mark:
derek: eu-west p95 elevated by ~12ms but under p99 threshold. no action required there yet.
maria: plan update: keep global canary at 5% for additional 15m. if p99 exceeds 260ms for 3m anywhere or 5xx >0.8% for 2m we pause and roll back. ajay open revert PR for allocator change.
ajay: PR draft created: https://git.internal/rw/runtime/pull/5427  includes revert, test plan, and rollback steps.
observability-bot: snapshot @ +15m: global p99=205ms, us-west p99=200ms post-pin, global 5xx=0.13%.
maria: leaving partial pin on us-west until next deploy window. will keep infra and support in the loop. tagging: @infra-team @support-oncall
lee: noted. will add ops notes to release ticket and include the allocator revert as a follow-on.
maria: thanks all. if anything changes i'll update here. :thumbsup:
